# Silence on the harbour archive recording

A long pause follows the question about the dock closure. My first transcript marked it as missing audio. It was not missing. The harbour archive needs a convention for pauses that doesn't turn hesitation into a technical defect. Play the clip back to the speaker before adding my interpretation. [[Listening]]: leaving space can be an action, but we cannot infer why someone stayed quiet.
